companyDescription: eVTOL Air Taxi · FAA Type Certification Phase 4 · First commercial air taxi operations in the US expected 2026
priceNote: Near 52-week low ($4.80–$14.62). FAA Phase 4 cert nearing — CEO says initial US ops in 2026. Cathie Wood sold $12.3M Jun 8 (short-term pressure).
summary: ACHR is the highest-conviction eVTOL binary bet. FAA Type Certification is in Phase 4 (final phase) with 100% of 797 Means of Compliance accepted. CEO guided initial US commercial operations in 2026. $1.2B liquidity runway gives 3+ years. Moon case: FAA cert → United Airlines ops → 400%+ from current price. Bear case: lawsuits (ACHR vs JOBY vs Vertical) delay cert indefinitely.
